title: Enhancing Know-Your-Upstream-Provider Requirements and Strengthening STIR/SHAKEN (Call Authentication Trust Anchor; Advanced Methods to Target and Eliminate Unlawful Robocalls)
pass_4_primary_concern: The proposal's anti-robocall goals are clear, but several core implementation and evidence questions remain unresolved, especially around how providers will verify upstream legitimacy, measure compliance, and avoid overbroad data collection.
pass_5_high_stakes_domain_reason: The proposal regulates telecom compliance and consumer call protection, but it is not a life-or-death or directly liberty-depriving domain.
pass_5_concise_why: The proposal is substantial, but the excerpt still leaves verification, burden, and special-case boundaries unresolved.
pass_5_most_important_consequence: If finalized without tighter verification and scoping rules, the package could impose broad compliance costs without enough evidence that each lever is necessary.
